author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: US agencies warn attackers are going after industrial refrigeration controllers. The fixes are basic, and most start with getting them off the internet. title: CISA and the FBI Warn Of Attacks against Industrial Refrigeration Controllers

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Fake GitHub security tools are spreading malware that disables defenses, steals sensitive data and infects over 2,000 PCs. title: Fake GitHub Security Tools Infect Over 2,000 PCs With Malware

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: The BBC plans to use emergency FM radio to keep the UK informed during prolonged blackouts, with a self-sufficient studio ready for 72 hours.
